description:
Source issue: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834
Parent contract: zaq-zqq (read before implementation).

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
lib/zaq/agent/executor.ex, request_control.ex, history_loader.ex; history_sync.ex only if needed for completed-message rendering integration. Fetch persisted presentation facts via existing trusted execution responses, not fresh clock/channel-name guesses. Render once before supplying messages to Jido using InputPrompt. Remove Executor.timestamp_question/1 and old HistoryLoader inline author/time prefixes. Move legacy loader data access to the domain reads from the prerequisite task. Preserve raw input for admission, queue receipt matching and persistence. Existing Jido message/execution identity refs remain unchanged; do not store author/time refs, refresh names, add invalidation or change RequestTransformer rendering.
Tests to add before implementation: actual model-bound input for alternating participants; immediate/queued/steering/injected inputs; intentionally old provider timestamp processed later; recorded-time fallback; non-persisted input with/without trusted time; canonical/legacy cold restoration; completion synchronization; attachment-only and multimodal preservation; no double prefixes.
Branches/paths validated: trusted persisted message fields override mismatching incoming presentation hints; queue/followup retains exact original attribution/time; current directory names resolve at preparation/load only. No changes to exact-content authorization, history cursors, request leases, role mapping or native tool-call identity. Existing model budgeting sees the real rendered string.
Mocking plan: real Engine/People/Jido pipeline and scripted external LLM provider; deterministic timestamps, no sleeps to simulate queue delay.
Documentations to update: Executor/RequestControl/HistoryLoader contracts and docs/services/agent.md, including no live rename-refresh guarantee.
Action reuse assessment: reuse authorized Engine operations and shared InputPrompt rendering. No Person queries or duplicate fallback policy in Agent leaf modules. Keep queue and runtime lifecycle APIs authoritative and test their existing permission/error paths.
Acceptance: live and restored representations of the same persisted message agree on author and message-time provenance; processing delay cannot alter message time.
title: [#834] Wire normalized presentation into immediate queued and restored inputs
